name: exportin 6

function.text: XPO6 is the approved symbol for exportin 6. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in nuclear export signal receptor activity; small GTPase binding; protein export from nucleus.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Lung adenocarcinoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.
